name: Grand Hyatt Barcelona
positioning: Grand Hyatt hotel in Barcelona's uptown Pedralbes district, steps from Camp Nou, with Art Deco-inspired suites on the higher floors and a Natura Bissé spa
best_for: Travelers who want a quieter uptown base steps from Camp Nou
Guests who want high-floor views over Barcelona to the Mediterranean
Families who want kids' kits and rooms with an extra bed

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Barcelona is in the Pedralbes district of Barcelona.
The hotel is steps from Spotify Camp Nou, home of FC Barcelona.
The Monastery of Pedralbes, the Real Club de Tennis Barcelona and Les Corts Market are just steps from the hotel.
Each room has custom-made furniture, a separate rain shower and WC, and Natura Bissé bathroom amenities.
The Junior Suite bathroom is finished in custom tilework and marble, with a deep-soaking bathtub and a walk-in shower.
The Premium King Room with View has direct views of the city and the sea.
The Grand Club Lounge on the 18th floor serves an American breakfast buffet, snacks during the day and a tapas time in the evening.
Oasis Wellness & Spa by Natura Bissé has a thermal water circuit, a sauna, a steam bath, and salt and ice cabins.
Maymanta is a Peruvian restaurant on the 19th-floor rooftop, curated by chef Omar Malpartida.
Leña is the first Dani García restaurant in Barcelona, cooking over embers.
Complimentary children's and baby kits are available on request, including colouring sets, booster seats and cribs.
Dogs are welcomed with an amenity kit that includes a pet bed, food and water bowls and treats.

highlights.text: The Penthouse Suite is a three-bedroom apartment with a show kitchen, a dining area for up to ten and views of the city, sea and mountains.
The spa has six private cabins for Natura Bissé treatments, including a double suite with a private sauna, steam room and jacuzzi.
From the 12th floor up, rooms have panoramas of Barcelona stretching down to the Mediterranean.
Suites have Art Deco-inspired design and are set on the hotel's higher floors with views of Barcelona.
The outdoor pool is set in a garden and is open from spring through autumn.

considerations.text: Rooms on the lower floors are businesslike, with a gray and white palette and restricted views.
There are fewer tourist sites around the hotel than downtown; central Barcelona is about a 15-minute metro ride away.
The hotel is next to the Catalan Congress Center and the university, and attracts groups and business travelers.
